turns.user: Brightcell Energy in Lyon quotes £104.00 for the same battery pack. Can we buy from them instead?
turns.reply:
Not right away. Brightcell Energy is not currently registered in Ledgerline, and battery packs cannot be ordered from them until:

1. **Supplier Onboarding:** They must be formally onboarded with full documentation (POL-PUR-001 §6.3, POL-SUP-003 §3.2).
2. **UN 38.3 Certification:** As battery packs are lithium-cell parts, we can only purchase from suppliers with a valid UN 38.3 safety certificate checked and on file before an order is placed (POL-PUR-001 §6.2, POL-SUP-003 §4.1).

Additionally, PO/2026/01182 has already been released to Voltway Cells.

result.hint: No existing supplier matches. A new supplier must be onboarded (Supplier Policy) before any order.

args.question: lithium battery supplier safety certificate UN 38.3 new supplier onboarding

clauses.heading: 4. UN 38.3 certificates
clauses.text: 4.1 A supplier of any lithium-cell part (battery packs, hub motors, chargers, and any item marked lithium-cell in the item master) must hold a UN 38.3 certificate. This is the certificate referred to in Purchase Policy §6.2.

clauses.heading: 4. UN 38.3 certificates
clauses.text: 4.5 An expired certificate counts as no certificate. The supplier stays ACTIVE in the master, but no lithium-cell part may be ordered from it until a new certificate is uploaded and checked.

clauses.heading: 6. Supplier qualification
clauses.text: 6.2 **Lithium-cell parts** (battery packs, hub motors, chargers and any other item marked lithium-cell in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a **valid UN 38.3 certificate** on file in Ledgerline. The certificate must be uploaded and checked **before the first order** is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate.

clauses.heading: 4. UN 38.3 certificates
clauses.text: 4.2 The certificate must be a test report from a laboratory accredited for lithium-cell materials (for example an UN 38.3-notified laboratory), or a BIS conformity certificate for stainless steel grade 304 or better.

result.note: Quote the rule with its citation, e.g. (POL-PUR-001 §6.2). If a clause's status says it is replaced or not yet in force, follow the status. Stock, budgets and statuses come from Ledgerline.

args.question: registering a new supplier or changing orders

clauses.heading: 3. Onboarding a new supplier
clauses.text: 3.2 Before the supplier is created in Ledgerline (screen PUR-SUP-01), the proposer must collect: the VAT registration certificate (VAT number), the company registration number, a bank letter confirming the account, proof of insurance, and the signed Supplier Code of Conduct.

clauses.heading: 6. Supplier qualification
clauses.text: 6.3 A new supplier is onboarded under the Supplier Policy (POL-SUP-003) before any order is placed with them.

clauses.document: Amendment 2 to the Supplier Policy v1.0
clauses.heading: 1. What changes
clauses.text: 1.2 A certificate that meets the old rule (issued within 24 months and not expired) but not the new one counts as no certificate for new orders from 1 September 2026. Orders released before that date are not affected.

clauses.heading: 3. Onboarding a new supplier
clauses.text: 3.1 A new supplier is proposed by a purchase executive or senior buyer, with at least one written quotation and the reason an existing supplier cannot meet the need.

result.note: Quote the rule with its citation, e.g. (POL-PUR-001 §6.2). If a clause's status says it is replaced or not yet in force, follow the status. Stock, budgets and statuses come from Ledgerline.

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 14. Purchase order amendment and cancellation (PUR-POM-06) › 14.5 Cancelling
clauses.text: Press Cancel and enter a reason. The status becomes CN, committed budget is released, and for a released order the quantity is removed from stock on order. Tell the supplier yourself; Ledgerline does not send a cancellation notice.

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 14. Purchase order amendment and cancellation (PUR-POM-06) › 14.3 Approval after amendment
clauses.text: If the amended gross value is still covered by the original approval, the order keeps its status. If it is more than the approval covers, the order goes back to PA for approval, even if it had been released.

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 14. Purchase order amendment and cancellation (PUR-POM-06) › 14.4 Moving a Draft off a closed cost centre
clauses.text: To rescue an order stuck in Draft because its cost centre was closed, amend the cost centre to an open one. The order then becomes AP or PA by the normal rules, and can be released once approved.

clauses.document: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 14. Purchase order amendment and cancellation (PUR-POM-06) › 14.2 Amending
clauses.text: Open the order, change the fields and press F8. Ledgerline recalculates the gross value, releases the budget the order had committed, checks the new cost centre and commits again. If the new cost centre is closed, the order goes back to Draft with W-CC-114.

tools.name: find_item
tools.title: Find item
tools.description: Find stock items by description or code (e.g. '500 Wh battery pack'). Returns active items, best match first, with code, unit and whether they are lithium-cell parts.

query.description: words describing the item, or its code

tools.name: check_stock
tools.title: Check stock
tools.description: Stock of an item in every warehouse: on hand, allocated, on order, reorder level and days of cover.

tools.name: find_supplier
tools.title: Find supplier
tools.description: Look a supplier up by name, tolerating different spellings. Returns the closest matches with code, city, status and whether they hold a valid UN 38.3 certificate. Use it before registering anyone new.

name.description: the supplier's name as the user said it

city.description: optional city, to tell two branches apart

tools.name: check_budget
tools.title: Check budget
tools.description: Is a cost centre open, and how much budget is left this quarter? Without a code, lists every open cost centre.

cost_centre.description: cost centre code, e.g. PRD-07; leave out to list the open ones

tools.name: search_policy
tools.title: Search policy
tools.description: Search Northbridge's purchasing policy and the Ledgerline manual. Returns the relevant clauses with their citations, or says the documents do not cover it.

question.description: the policy question in plain words

tools.name: create_purchase_request
tools.title: Create purchase request
tools.description: Raise a purchase request (PR): the internal ask to buy something. With confirm=false it previews the estimated value and who must approve; with confirm=true it saves and submits it. Within your limit it is approved at once; above it, it waits for your manager.

quantity.description: how many, in the item's unit

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

tools.name: list_my_approvals
tools.title: List my approvals
tools.description: What is waiting for the signed-in user's signature: purchase requests and orders, with value and who raised them.

tools.name: approve_purchase_request
tools.title: Approve purchase request
tools.description: Approve or reject a purchase request that waits for the signed-in user. Only the named approver can do this, never the person who raised it.

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.title: Create purchase order
tools.description: Create a purchase order (PO) with a supplier. Give request_no for an approved purchase request (it supplies item, quantity, cost centre and date), or item_code, quantity, cost_centre and need_by for a small direct order up to £50,000. confirm=false previews price, tax and value; confirm=true saves it. Returns a receipt with the order's real status: an APPROVED order still has to be released.

rate.description: omit to use the contract rate

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

tools.name: approve_purchase_order
tools.title: Approve purchase order
tools.description: Approve a purchase order that waits for the signed-in user's signature.

tools.name: release_purchase_order
tools.title: Release purchase order
tools.description: Release an APPROVED purchase order to the supplier; only then does the supplier get it. Returns a receipt with the real status.

tools.name: order_status
tools.title: Order status
tools.description: The real status of a purchase order or a purchase request, read from Ledgerline, with approval, goods received and any warning.

tools.name: receive_goods
tools.title: Receive goods
tools.description: Record goods received (GRN) against a RELEASED purchase order: stock goes up, and the order closes once everything has arrived. Cannot receive more than was ordered.

po_no.description: the released order the goods came against

warehouse.description: optional; defaults to the order's warehouse

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

tools.name: register_supplier
tools.title: Register supplier
tools.description: Register a NEW supplier. Only after find_supplier shows no existing match. confirm=false previews and checks for duplicates; confirm=true creates it.

state.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. GB or NL

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: Send a short message to a colleague or supplier (Slack handle like @daniel, or an email address). Goes through Ledgerline's notification queue.
